statements.attributed: derived phase formation rules for well-studied bulk high-entropy alloy materials
statements.quote: We launched a composition prescreening process to identify solid solution structures based on the phase formation rules derived in well-studied bulk high-entropy alloy materials (, , ), where the solid solution phase usually meets the following criteria: (i) atomic differences (δ ≤ 6.5%), (ii) mixing enthalpy (−11.6 < ΔHmix < 3.2 kJ/mol), and (iii) Gibbs free energy (alloy mixing ΔGmix = ∆Hmix − T∆Smix < intermetallic ΔGIM = ∆HIM − T∆SIM).
